comps.label: C1
comps.reason: Builds and sells single-family and attached homes to first-time, move-up and active adult buyers, with in-house title and mortgage services.

comps.label: C2
comps.reason: Homebuilder selling detached and attached homes to individual buyers with captive mortgage financing, though it also has rental and lot-sale lines.

comps.label: C3
comps.reason: Builds and sells single-family homes and townhomes to first-time buyers, with in-house mortgage and title services for the same buyers.

comps.label: C4
comps.reason: Develops raw land into lots sold B2B to homebuilders; it does not build or sell homes to individual buyers.

comps.label: C5
comps.reason: Builds and sells single-family homes and townhomes to individual buyers, with captive mortgage financing and some lot sales.

comps.label: C6
comps.reason: Builds and sells detached and attached homes to first-time, move-up and active adult buyers, with mortgage and title subsidiaries.

comps.label: C7
comps.reason: Insurance underwriter selling title, mortgage guaranty and commercial policies; it does not build or sell homes.

comps.label: C8
comps.reason: Sells life insurance, cemetery and mortuary services alongside mortgages; homebuilding is absent from its business.

comps.label: C9
comps.reason: Title insurer and software and data provider; it does not build or sell residential homes to buyers.
